lead: `Parses::tryParse` does not resolve on a user implementor, though the interface declares it with a body.
body: `crates/nvs-types/src/iter_lib.rs:123` seeds `tryParse` with `has_body = true`, so it reads as available, but `Slug::tryParse("x")` on a class implementing `Parses` is `E0309: 'Slug' has no method named 'tryParse'` — only `parse` is reachable. Write `parse` with a `catch` where you wanted the pair, and never put `tryParse` on a user class in a `docs/reference/` example, because `bun nv reference` (`tools/nv/cmd/reference.ts`) compiles every one of them.
